feeds.description: The Third Eye is a blog that covers psychedelic rock and its subgenres. The blog was started in 2022 by Nick to discover new psychedelic music. The Third Eye covers the past, present, and future of psychedelic rock. The Third Eye strives to be a independent resource for psychedelic musicians, fans, and artists by promoting and reviewing the best new psychedelic music.
